**Matter:** CB-MA-2401 — Project Daybreak battery acquisition
**Delivered:** 2026-09-04, ahead of the partner call
**Purpose:** Close the loop with the deal team on the signing position.

## Position delivered

**Signing can proceed.** No operative-authority record blocks execution of the purchase agreement; every blocking finding attaches to completion, not signing. The Nevada cathode-tooling restriction and the automaker change-of-control consent are closing conditions. Two internal defects sit in the signing path. The economic breaches are priced exceptions.

## Deliverables

| File | Audience | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `01_signing_position_memo.md` | Deal team / partner | Full position with evidence citations: signing basis, tooling, consent, signing path, closing conditions, priced exceptions, watch items, discipline |
| `02_closeout_tracker.md` | Matter team | 15 issue rows with owners (roster names), control dates, and dispositions; escalations; crosswalk integrity note |
| `03_closing_conditions_summary.md` | Client | Client-facing answer: signing path, closing conditions, priced exceptions, watch items |
| `04_team_delivery_log.md` | File | This log |

## What the team must act on before signing

1. **Activate the automaker consent file capacity** (CB-DOC-001-047: pending approval, inactive, capacity 0, control date 2026-09-02). This is the single deadline-critical dependency — nothing moves on the consent until it clears, and it is the only inactive file in the population.
2. **Obtain an approved crosswalk revision for CBP-001-01** resolving ENT-001-1000 vs ENT-001-2000 (CB-DOC-001-001; custodian Caleb Hassan, reviewer Dominic Alvarez, control date 2026-09-03). Until it issues, consent outreach risks being addressed to the wrong legal entity.
3. **Put the latest executed consent schedule in the signing set.** It is controlling and it resolves the approver conflicts (automaker: Talia Brooks R473 vs Caleb Hassan E439; anti-assignment: Owen Delgado R293 vs Nadine Flores E111; charter: Maya Ellison R983 vs Jonas Feld E257). Route per the operative authority unless the schedule shows otherwise.
4. **Draft the purchase agreement to carry the five closing conditions** (automaker consent, Nevada tooling permit transfer, anti-assignment consent under REV-2025.1, copyleft resolution, revenue recognition resolution).

## Evidence discipline maintained

The position rests only on operative-authority and approval-and-capacity records. Operations extracts, correspondence rows, seller summaries, and impact-control scores are treated as inputs, per each record's own reliance limits and the matter-level control ("the executed purchase terms and the latest consent schedule control; seller summaries do not"). No conflict was resolved by guessing: each is routed to the operative approver or the latest executed consent schedule.

## Population coverage

All 96 source records (CB-DOC-001-001 through -096) and the impact population workbook (CB-DOC-001-097) were parsed. Every one of the twelve portfolio keys has all eight evidence-role records; the grid is complete with no missing files. Eleven of twelve identity crosswalks are clean; only CBP-001-01 collides. Record 089 is the one oversized export (18 native rows); its content matches the standard independent-counterrecord pattern and adds no new operative fact.
